whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Well, I've always been interested in light. You begin to notice the light, the quality of light, the color of light, how it falls on subjects. You're always aware, whether you have a camera or not, you become aware constantly of light. So I just got into the light and the color, you know. I mean, shapes and face are wonderful, but I wanted to stop any kind of classical representation of an object.
